info.name: NAISA Venue Submissions - Operations 8-9
info.description: AI-generated with Codex. Author: Vincent Lai, Codex. Run this entire collection in order against a disposable test database. Start the service and apply api-tests/seed.sql first. Creates fresh clients, venues, and reviews on every run; it does not clean them up. See docs/server/venue-apis.md and docs/server/development.md.

item.name: 0. Setup - issue two independent client keys

exec: pm.test("Persisted venue fields", () => { const v=pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(v.name).to.eql("Submission API Court"); pm.expect(v.address).to.eql("1 Test Street"); pm.expect(v.latitude).to.be.closeTo(40.812345, 0.0000001); pm.expect(v.longitude).to.be.closeTo(-73.961234, 0.0000001); pm.expect(v.timezone).to.eql("America/New_York"); pm.expect(v.sports).to.eql([]); pm.expect(v.openingIntervals).to.eql([]); });

item.name: 3. rateVenue - create, update, and isolate review scopes
Update same reviewer and scope at lower rating boundary
Explicit null sport updates whole-venue review
Different external user gets independent review
Second client updates only its own review
Sport review is independent from whole-venue review
